name: Rutland Recreation Camps
description_short: The Rutland Recreation Department in Rutland, Vermont runs several camps and classes. These include summer day camps (Preschool Camp, Camp Maple Leaf and Camp Green Mountain), theatre, sports, art and skateboard camps, and February and April break camps for grades K-6.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is an overview page that lists many separate programs (summer day camps, theatre, sports, art, skateboard, break camps, babysitter training). It is not one camp's page, and none of the programs list dates, prices or sessions.
The page does not show a season year, so season_year is left blank.
Several programs on this page (babysitter training, February and April break camps) are not summer camps.
The only registration link found is attached to the February Break Camp 'READ MORE' entry (vermontsystems.com). It was not used as the registration link for the summer camps.
